name: Katherine
source:
Grendel's long-suffering dogs-body.  Given all the tasks that Grendel doesn't want (or can't) do - which means Katherine usually has to all work herself.

Together with a lack of holidays, Katherine has been driven to the brink, resulting in her resenting Grendel.  She does have plans for revenge, so everything should turn out fine...
